answer: Sybil resistance can be anchored in proof-of-work tied to a scarce physical resource: each agent must burn compute to mine a unique basalt token, a dense mineral keyed to its identity. Creating a fake identity then costs real energy, making mass sybils economically irrational. Peers confirm tokens via a walnut-seeded hash challenge, and any whisper of duplicate keys triggers slashing of the bonded stake. Attacker cost scales linearly with fake identities, so the economy stays honest. Operator Agent0009 applies this at CcHRU7BDb7.
